summary.detail: Doctoral programmes of 3-4 academic years, instructed in Chinese generally, with some English-taught programmes. Applicants must be master's degree holders. The English-taught catalogue (2026) lists about 86 disciplines across the faculties and the ZJU International Campus. Most scholarships have no major restriction; some are limited to named fields (China Studies fellowship: humanities and social science programmes; China-ASEAN Oceanic Scholarship: Ocean College programmes; ZJU International School of Medicine Scholarship: ISM programmes; College of Optical Science and Engineering Scholarship: its programmes; ZJE Hai Scholarship: ZJE applicants).

summary.detail: Yenching Academy of Peking University Master’s Program in China Studies: an interdisciplinary programme, two years, fully funded and residential. The Yenching Fellowship covers tuition, on-campus accommodation, a travel stipend, monthly stipend, medical insurance and research-trip expenses in the first year, with a second-year fellowship for scholars in good standing who stay in Beijing. Six China Studies research areas. The 2027 admissions page requires a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in any field and English-language applications.
summary.source_text: The Yenching Academy Master’s Program in China Studies is two years in duration.

notes: Programme areas are from the 2026-entry page (29 October 2025); the 2027 Admissions page (yenchingacademy.pku.edu.cn/ADMISSIONS.htm) does not name the degree or the research areas, and no 2027-entry programme page was found, so the 2026 list is the latest published.
PKU's 2026 English-taught master's catalogue for Yenching Academy lists the same six China Studies majors with codes 0101J2, 0202J2, 0301J2, 0302J2, 0501J2, 0602J2 (full-time, English).
The 2027 admissions page does not itself use the word master's; the degree is stated on the 2026-entry page and in PKU's catalogue. The website's degrees_now is currently empty and should be master.

summary.detail: One-year, fully funded Master of Global Affairs at Tsinghua University, Beijing; all teaching in English. Core curriculum plus electives from many disciplines; students are not required to focus electives in one area, and no fixed concentrations or tracks are published. Any undergraduate field of study is accepted.
summary.source_text: a prestigious one-year, fully funded master’s program in global affairs at Tsinghua University

programmes.name: Master of Global Affairs
programmes.source_text: anchored in a rigorous and immersive Master of Global Affairs degree program at Tsinghua University

notes: Curriculum page: Scholars choose electives from a variety of academic disciplines and may take courses in other English language master's programmes at Tsinghua (law, public health, public policy, international relations, environmental studies, business, education and more); electives listed are for 2025-2026.
Language: the admissions page says 'all teaching will be conducted in English' (https://www.schwarzmanscholars.org/admissions/).
